_note: Who answers and who validates unit work (C-07, C-25; technical-architecture 16.5). Roles are the stored values: product_manager is shown as Unit manager, design_engineer as Unit designer / engineer. Technical items are the matcher's product categories (technical, compliance) and go to the unit's designers / engineers. Routing decided 16 Oct 2026 (open question 2 of changes-iteration3.md): only high-level, consolidated non-technical requirements stay on the bid desk (here: submission and legal, answered once for the whole bid); the non-technical categories in unit_manager_categories go to every participating unit's manager. Changing the sequence is a change to this file, not to code.
